profile.summary: A nonprofit based in Chicago that helps school districts, universities and other partners design, launch and strengthen teacher residency and registered apprenticeship programs. It also provides support for mentor teachers, conducts research on teacher preparation programs, and advocates for policies that support teacher residencies. It was founded in 2007.
